name: Andalusian Warriors

abilities.name: Shield Wall
abilities.text: The unit moves into a close formation and raises shields.

attributes.name: Hide (forest)
attributes.text: This unit can hide in forests until enemy units get too close.

short: Their homeland is rich in wood and iron; these men make good use of its gifts on the field.
history: Men who signed up to fight in the Andalusian armies of the Umayyad Caliphate were usually motivated by their religious beliefs, as was generally the case right across the burgeoning Islamic empire. Spain was an extremely wealthy territory due to its iron and silver resources. These seams, mined by both Carthage and Rome in centuries past, were reopened by the Umayyads, who then used the resultant wealth to import well-made weapons and armour from across Europe as well as creating their own. Less is known about Andalusian infantry than their cavalry, save that they represented the bulk of Umayyad armies in the region at a time when its cavalry was considered inferior and insufficient for purpose compared to that of their western European rivals.
strengths: Very low damage and armour penetration
